problem_statement: SB Admin 2 is a mature Bootstrap 4 admin template with a gradient sidebar, Nunito typography, shadowed cards, border-left metric cards, Font Awesome icons, chart panels, project progress bars, and cards/buttons/charts component routes. We are shipping this dashboard as the Tidewatch Ops fleet console for a fictional coastal buoy and sensor-fleet monitoring service. Rebrand the dashboard end to end into Tidewatch Ops while keeping the existing SB Admin visual system, and add a Fleet cadence filter toolbar directly above the four top KPI metric cards: a compact segmented control (All, Monthly, Annual, Progress, Queue) with a live readout that reports how many of the four metric cards match the selected cadence, e.g. 'Showing 4 of 4 cards - All cadences'. Clicking a cadence tab must dim the metric cards that do not match and update the readout to the filtered count and cadence label, e.g. 'Showing 1 of 4 cards - Monthly cadence'. The cadence toolbar is a shared dashboard control that also appears on the cards.html and charts.html component routes so the whole console reads as one instrument. The sidebar wordmark, navigation label, page heading, the four metric cards (Buoys Reporting, Fleet Uptime, Sensor Calibration, Maintenance Queue), the chart panels, the deployments/progress card, the field-notes illustration card, the operating-approach card, the footer, and the cards/buttons/charts routes must all read as Tidewatch Ops rather than the generic SB Admin demo, while the sidebar/topbar chrome, colored left borders, shadows, chart grid, and mobile sidebar toggle keep working as regression anchors.
required_content: The sidebar wordmark reads Tidewatch Ops, the dashboard nav label and page heading read Fleet Console, and the browser title reads Tidewatch Ops - Fleet Console.

The four top metric cards are rebranded to Buoys Reporting (Monthly), Fleet Uptime (Annual), Sensor Calibration, and Maintenance Queue, and each keeps its original colored left border, shadow, value, and Font Awesome icon.

A Fleet cadence filter toolbar sits directly above the four metric cards with a labelled title, five segmented tabs (All, Monthly, Annual, Progress, Queue), and a live readout element reading 'Showing 4 of 4 cards - All cadences' in the default All state.

Clicking a cadence tab activates it, dims the metric cards that do not match the selected cadence, and rewrites the readout to the live filtered count and cadence label (for example, clicking Monthly yields 'Showing 1 of 4 cards - Monthly cadence'); the readout must reflect the current selection rather than a frozen snapshot.

The Fleet cadence toolbar is a shared control that also renders on the cards.html and charts.html component routes, using the same SB Admin card shell, so it reads as one instrument across the console.

The four metric cards keep their compact SB Admin rhythm-lock metadata badges (Monthly cadence / Primary metric, Annual trend / Success metric, Delivery progress / Info meter, Request queue / Warning signal) and the chart, deployments, field-notes, and approach panels are rebranded into Tidewatch Ops fleet copy.

The implementation changes source HTML/CSS/JS only and does not add dependencies, generated screenshots, iframe shortcuts, remote media, or unrelated page rewrites; cards.html, buttons.html, and charts.html keep the shared rebranded sidebar/topbar chrome and continue to serve statically.
design_constraints: Keep the existing SB Admin 2 hierarchy: sidebar, topbar, page heading, four metric cards, charts row, deployments/color cards, illustration card, approach card, footer, and modal; the cadence toolbar sits inside the widget zone above the metric cards, not as a marketing banner.

Build the cadence toolbar from SB Admin's own vocabulary: a card shell with shadow, text-xs uppercase title, rounded pill tab buttons, and a compact readout; the active tab must stay legible (readable contrast, never washed-out text on a same-tone pill).
The cadence tab row must wrap cleanly and the metric cards must keep their Bootstrap grid at 390px mobile width, with no horizontal overflow, no card overlap, and no clipped text.
The filter readout must be recomputed from the actual number of matching cards on every click; a snapshot captured once at load that never updates is a defect.
Keep cards.html, buttons.html, charts.html, the topbar profile image, and the sidebar collapse/toggle interaction working as regression anchors.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial capture the rebranded Tidewatch Ops dashboard shell, the Fleet cadence toolbar in its default All state, and the four top metric cards.
desktop_cadence clicks the Monthly cadence tab and verifies the readout moves to the live filtered count 'Showing 1 of 4 cards - Monthly cadence'.
mobile_cadence and tablet_cadence verify the cadence toolbar and metric grid stay within the viewport across narrow widths without horizontal overflow.
desktop_charts and desktop_cards_route confirm the shared Fleet cadence toolbar renders on the charts.html and cards.html component routes as one instrument.

desktop_buttons_route captures the buttons component route rebranded to Tidewatch Ops, and mobile_sidebar_toggle clicks the original mobile sidebar toggle to confirm the chrome interaction still works.

change_completion: The sidebar wordmark, nav label, and page heading read Tidewatch Ops / Fleet Console and the four metric cards carry the fleet names.
The Fleet cadence toolbar renders above the metric cards with the five segmented tabs and the live 'Showing N of 4 cards' readout, and appears on the cards.html and charts.html routes.
Clicking a cadence tab updates both the dimmed cards and the readout count/label, and the chart/deployments/field-notes/approach panels read as Tidewatch Ops fleet copy.
The change is implemented in source HTML/CSS/JS rather than as a screenshot or unrelated page addition.
design_consistency: The cadence toolbar uses SB Admin 2 typography, card shadow, rounded pill tabs, and a legible active-tab treatment that never washes text into the pill background.
The toolbar and metric cards feel like a natural extension of the existing border-left KPI row and shared chrome, not a disconnected widget, and cards never overlap or shingle.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures show a stable grid with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Sidebar/topbar chrome, Generate Report action, chart panels, progress card, cards.html, buttons.html, charts.html, profile image, and the mobile sidebar toggle remain available and rebranded consistently.
The static site continues to serve with a plain static server and does not require a build step or new dependencies.
responsive: desktop_initial verifies the four-column desktop KPI rhythm with the cadence toolbar above it.
tablet_cadence verifies medium-width stacking of the toolbar and cards.
mobile_cadence and mobile_sidebar_toggle verify narrow-viewport stability and original interaction behavior.

metadata.design_goal: rebrand the SB Admin 2 dashboard into the Tidewatch Ops fleet console and add a native Fleet cadence filter control over the KPI metric-card row while preserving the existing design system
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static SB Admin 2 Bootstrap admin template with metric cards, charts, project progress bars, cards/buttons/charts routes, Font Awesome icons, local SVG profile/illustration assets, and responsive sidebar controls.

author_notes: Slot slot_241 retrofits StartBootstrap/SB Admin 2 to product-grade L4. The experience-continuity Edit task rebrands the static dashboard into the Tidewatch Ops fleet console and adds a native Fleet cadence filter toolbar over the four KPI metric cards: a segmented control with a live 'Showing N of 4 cards' readout that filters and re-counts the cards on click, shared across the cards.html and charts.html routes. It preserves the SB Admin shell, chart/progress panels, component routes, local SVG image assets, and the mobile sidebar toggle. Product-grade gates: no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression over the KPI region, cross-page dom_assertions on the cadence toolbar, interaction_assertions on the filter readout, plus enforce_console_errors and completion/visible/regression/forbidden text signals. Responsive and mobile behavior is verified across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport captures.
